title: Cynara scolymus essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Cynara scolymus essential oil is derived from the flowers of the artichoke plant, known for its potent aromatic compounds. This essential oil is used in herbalism for its digestive and liver-supporting properties. It is often employed to aid in the treatment of digestive disorders and to promote detoxification. The oil may also help alleviate symptoms of bloating and indigestion. Due to its strength, it is typically diluted before use in topical applications or aromatherapy.
